headline: Russia and Ukraine Keep Hitting Energy Targets Despite Truce Talk
seoTitle: Russia and Ukraine Continue Energy Strikes Despite Truce Talk | FMB Worldwide
seoDescription: Russia and Ukraine continued attacks on energy-related targets despite U.S. claims of an agreement to halt such strikes, showing that no effective mutual pause is yet in place.
deck: Around 200 Russian drones were launched overnight, Ukrainian authorities said, while Ukraine reported strikes on Russia’s Syzran refinery and drone-production facilities.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Russia and Ukraine continued striking energy-related infrastructure despite diplomatic discussion of a halt to such attacks.
Ukrainian authorities said Russia launched around 200 drones overnight, damaging petrol stations and other infrastructure and killing two people.
Ukraine, meanwhile, said it struck Russia’s Syzran oil refinery and facilities associated with drone production.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: U.S. President Donald Trump had said the sides agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Kyiv could support such a pause if there were credible guarantees of reciprocal Russian compliance.
The continued strikes show that whatever diplomatic understanding has been discussed has not yet produced an effective, observable mutual halt.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Energy infrastructure has become a strategic target because it affects military logistics, state revenue and civilian life.
The attacks also have international consequences: disruptions to Russian refining can add volatility to diesel and petroleum-product markets already under pressure from Middle East supply risks.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for a formal mechanism defining which facilities are protected, whether both sides publicly accept the same terms, and whether the frequency of energy strikes actually falls.

sources.title: Russia hits petrol station, warehouse facilities, Kyiv mayor says

verificationNotes: Russian drone figures and damage are attributed to Ukrainian authorities through Reuters.
The article does not describe the proposed energy truce as operational because strikes continued.
